weekly.source_note: Week-centered Niño-3.4 SST and anomaly from wksst9120.for. Not a phase.

oni.source_note: Three-month mean (TOTAL) and anomaly (ANOM) as printed. No phase is read from this row.

official_phase.note: Quoted from the ENSO Diagnostic Discussion. Not classified from the weekly anomaly.

official_phase_note: NOAA stated this status in the diagnostic discussion.
context: ENSO is a large-scale Pacific ocean-atmosphere pattern. NOAA uses it as context for Atlantic tropical cyclone activity. It does not set the depth on a Princeton road, and this app does not scale the scenario by ENSO.
